description: Ex-French spares-source Jaguar airframe, seen being set up Oct 2024; fully restored for display and marked A02 by Dec 2025; school replaced its wall with a grille so it is visible from the road. Source WoI (updated Jan 2026).
Ex-AP/Hyderabad Flying Club Chipmunk donated to the school, painted with IAF roundels, in a wire enclosure near the office block. Source WoI 2004 (still referenced 2025).
